mechanism: Sacubitril (ARNI) causes vasodilation and blood pressure reduction, while fluphenazine (typical antipsychotic) can cause orthostatic hypotension and QT prolongation, creating additive cardiovascular risks.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess orthostatic vital signs, obtain baseline ECG, and use lowest effective fluphenazine dose; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower orthostatic/QT risk if possible.
